external_baseline_lanes.next: Extend baseline comparison output into promotion reports, not direct live execution.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Time-series benchmark; useful only if it survives net-of-cost walk-forward gates.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Build separate evaluator for EUR/GBP/JPY/USD clusters and compare to ARIMA and tabular gates.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Needs multi-instrument synchronized matrices and cointegration tests.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Add ATR/GARCH volatility forecast columns to feature store, then validate as risk-control factor.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Forecasts volatility/risk, not direct direction. Better as position sizing and stop-distance input.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Train unsupervised regimes by pair family/session and add regime IDs/probabilities as features.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Regime model should label trend/range/risk-off/liquidity states before candidate models trade.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Prototype on pair baskets and feed residual/z-score features to tabular trainer.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Useful for dynamic beta/spread relationships and smoothing, not plain row classification.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Only add after tabular/regime baselines are stable; compare by net pips and drawdown, not raw accuracy.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: LSTM/TCN/Transformer models need GPU-aware training, strict leakage controls, and larger data windows.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Persist pair-level macro bias snapshots and join lagged bias to training rows.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Macro/GPT should veto, bias, or reduce risk. It should not be allowed as an unbacktested trigger.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Refresh the shadow ensemble manifest from validated members and promote only after it beats active production under comparable validation.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Best-model-per-pair needs portfolio exposure, pair-correlation, margin, and concentration control before it can drive execution.

external_baseline_lanes.next: Use paper-only challenger allocation after validated candidates have enough shadow trades.
external_baseline_lanes.reason: Useful for promotion/demotion and threshold selection, but dangerous without drawdown guardrails.
